description: Cloudflare WAF and Security Configuration Rules for VextOpenBank

waf_custom_rules.name: Block known malicious bots and scanners
waf_custom_rules.expression: (cf.threat_score gt 25) or (cf.client.bot and not http.user_agent contains "Googlebot")

waf_custom_rules.name: Protect sensitive MFA step-up and transfer write endpoints
waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/v1/security/mfa/verify" or http.request.uri.path contains "/api/v1/transfers/execute") and (ip.geoip.country ne "MA" and ip.geoip.country ne "FR")

zero_trust_access.description: Optional Cloudflare Access policy requiring Google / GitHub OAuth for OpenAPI docs /docs and /redoc
